gloss: to nod (in agreement); to say yes; to give one's consent

definitions.gloss: to nod (in agreement); to say yes; to consent
definitions.explanation: To nod one's head vertically, indicating agreement or approval. Often used in the negative to describe someone refusing to agree.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はなかなか{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}らない。
やっと{父|ちち}が{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}ってくれた。
examples.english: My father finally gave his approval.

examples.japanese: どんなに{説得|せっとく}しても、{彼女|かのじょ}は{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}ろうとしなかった。
examples.english: No matter how much I tried to persuade her, she wouldn't agree.

notes:
USAGE:
More often used in the NEGATIVE ({首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}らない) to describe refusal or reluctance to agree. The affirmative is used when emphasizing that consent was finally obtained.
More vivid and emphatic than simply {同意|どうい}する (to agree) or うなずく (to nod). Often used when the agreement or refusal is significant or hard-won.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}る (to nod yes)
- {首|くび}を{横|よこ}に{振|ふ}る (to shake one's head no)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- なかなか{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}らない (won't easily agree)
- やっと{首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}る (to finally agree)
- {首|くび}を{縦|たて}に{振|ふ}ろうとしない (to refuse to agree)
